summary: Full E2E testing of 6-box Hub dashboard + Nuovo Intervento CRUD + new launch banner. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases on /api/interventi PASS (create/list/update stato/delete, 403 for anon+privato, 400 for empty title, 404 for invalid id, DB persistence verified). Frontend: all requested flows PASS - public homepage launch-banner shows '€4,99/mese o €49,99/anno · Registrazione gratis' and is HIDDEN on /dashboard. Azienda login lands on /dashboard with azienda-quick-actions containing exactly 6 orange HubBox children (box-nuovo-intervento, box-scansione-ai, box-cerca-operai, box-wallet, box-profilo, box-annunci). box-wallet title shows real 'Wallet: 5 crediti'. No bottom tab menu, no 'Analisi Energetica AI' top button (count=0 in page HTML). box-nuovo-intervento -> /dashboard/nuovo-intervento shows interventi-panel; create+list+change stato+delete flow fully works; dashboard-back returns to /dashboard. box-cerca-operai, box-wallet, box-annunci route to their sub-paths. box-profilo -> /dashboard/profilo renders azienda-profile-form + gallery-panel + verification-panel + emergency-panel + subscription-panel stacked. box-scansione-ai navigates to /analisi-energetica. Redirects verified: /dashboard/azienda->/dashboard, /dashboard/foobar->/dashboard (unknown slug), /dashboard/analisi-energetica->/analisi-energetica. Role guards: privato lands on /area-privato and both /dashboard and /dashboard/wallet redirect privato back to /area-privato. Admin lands on /admin.

critical_code_review_comments: DashboardAzienda.jsx KNOWN_SECTIONS still includes 'richieste' as a valid slug (renders azienda-leads-list). It's not part of the 6-box hub but is still routable via /dashboard/richieste. Not necessarily a bug (dead-end but harmless), may be intentional. Consider removing or exposing it as a 7th hub box for clarity.
InterventiPanel delete action has no confirmation dialog - a single click permanently deletes an intervento. Minor UX risk for destructive action; consider AlertDialog.
Pricing inconsistency noted in review (banner €4,99 vs subscription panel €3,99) is intentional per instructions, not flagged as a bug.
